title: Word-Token Recurrent Toxicity Ensemble
summary: Comments are lowercased, regex-tokenized, head-truncated to 220 tokens, and mapped to a 120,000-word training-only vocabulary with padding and unknown IDs. Word embeddings are pretrained on training text using skip-gram negative sampling with frequency-based subsampling, then normalized and used to initialize each classifier. The classifier applies embedding spatial dropout, a bidirectional LSTM followed by a bidirectional GRU, then concatenates masked max and mean pools from both recurrent outputs with attention pooling from the GRU output. A residual ReLU/dropout dense block feeds one toxicity logit and one auxiliary logit per identity. Toxicity BCE is weighted by identity presence and toxicity/identity combinations, mean-normalized; unweighted BCE supervises identity heads. Six differently seeded models train for four epochs with length-bucketed shuffled batches, AdamW, epochwise learning-rate decay, mixed precision, and gradient clipping. Inference sigmoid-transforms toxicity logits, averages the final two epoch predictions per model, then averages across models.
